# Rahenda

> Personal website and blog of Rahenda, a product manager based in Rennes,
> France, with a background in engineering, stakeholder management, and
> B2B sales, with expertise in Cloud platform, API, and DevOps. 
> Site is in French (some content) and English (site chrome).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) for making a
site's key information directly retrievable by AI assistants without requiring
HTML scraping.

## Profile

- [About / Profile]({{ "/about.html" | absolute_url }}): Biography — career path from
  semiconductor manufacturing, to DevOps engineering, to cloud product
  management, to stakeholder management during 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris, to business
  development in API for B2B customers.
